name: gpt-image-2
description: Generate and edit images with OpenAI gpt-image-2.
long_description: MCP server for OpenAI's gpt-image-2 image generation model. Generate new images, edit existing ones with reference images and masks, and iterate on the last result. Jobs run in the background and are polled with check_image_job, so long generations never hit request timeouts.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Starts generating a NEW image with OpenAI gpt-image-2. Returns a jobId immediately; generation runs in the background (10–180s). You must call check_image_job(jobId) every ~5s until status is "completed". Use it only for brand-new images, not to modify existing ones.

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Starts editing a specific existing image file, optionally with additional reference images (up to 16 in total) and a PNG mask. Returns a jobId immediately; poll with check_image_job.

tools.name: continue_editing
tools.description: Starts editing the LAST image generated or edited in this session, optionally with reference images and a mask. Returns a jobId immediately; poll with check_image_job.

tools.name: check_image_job
tools.description: Polls the status of a job started by generate_image, edit_image or continue_editing. Returns { status: "pending" } while running, { status: "completed", ... } with the saved file path (and inline base64 if enabled), or { status: "failed", error }. Call it every 5–10s.

tools.name: get_configuration_status
tools.description: Checks whether the OpenAI API key is configured and which model is active.

tools.name: get_last_image_info
tools.description: Gets information about the last generated/edited image in this session.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: OpenAI API key with gpt-image-2 access. Get one at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys. Your organization must be verified to use the gpt-image family.

model.title: Model ID
model.description: Override the model. Leave as gpt-image-2 unless you need another one.

inline_image.title: Return inline image data
inline_image.description: Embed base64 image data in tool responses. Disable to save context window.
